messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concrete backstop plan for the MVP cut if the November window slips. customer asks + regulatory checks are creeping in.

devon: +1. Do we have a minimal technische list? Thinking: core API, auth, tenant routing, logs. everything else can be deferred.

sam: For inference workloads we should keep embeddings and the small reranker hot. Anything heavy (rerank-ensemble, cross-tenant batching) -> v1.

alex: Design note — we can ship with a simplified UX: no multi-tenant onboarding flow, single-step pilot. That saves ~3 sprints of front-end work.

jordan: From CS: two pilot customers (Acme, BetaCorp) said SSO and SLA are blockers, but they can accept a temporary manual onboarding if feature flagged.

maria: Proposal: baseline MVP = API surface (text gen + embeddings), single-tenant onboarding, basic telemetry + logs, SSO as enterprise opt-in (manual for pilots). Contention: do we include per-route cost breakdown?

devon: per-route cost breakdown is useful but backend heavy. We can ship a minimal cost meter (aggregate) and add per-route in v1.

sam: Also need a fallback model path in runtime routing if our preferred model is OOM. That’s a runtime safety item, not UI.

maria: Agreed. Key asks to track in the contingency plan:
```
- Keep: text generation endpoints, embeddings, auth, telemetry, dev docs
- Backstop (defer to v1): tenant-sso full flow, per-route billing, rerank-ensemble, large-quantized variants
- Runtime must: fallback routing, KV cache warmup, basic autoscaling policies
```

alex: UX tradeoff: hide advanced settings behind "Advanced" so pilots don't get confused.

jordan: Can we promise pilots the manual SSO path by GA? That keeps them onboard while we finish enterprise flow.

maria: Yes — manual SSO + documented checklist.

devon: Timeline question — if we lose one sprint, where do we pull from? I suggest pulling from analytics retention and per-route billing work.

sam: Also recommend a graded rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> GA with automatic fallback to lightweight model. Add a rollback checklist.

maria: Drafting a one-page contingency we can show execs. Outline: scope floor (what must be shipped), optional stretch (if on time), rollout & rollback playbook, customer mitigations.

devon: Sounds good. Can you include operational SLOs we need to hit for GA (p95 < 300ms small-gen, error rate < 1%)?

maria: Will add. Also add cost guardrails (max tokens/sec per tenant, burst caps).

jordan: I'll prep comms for Acme/BetaCorp about manual SSO and pilot expectations.

alex: I'll prototype the reduced onboarding screens today.

maria: Action items:
- maria: publish contingency one-pager by EOD tomorrow
- devon: identify minimal runtime changes for fallback + autoscale (ETA 2 days)
- sam: list models to keep hot + quantization recommendations (ETA 3 days)
- alex: prototype simplified onboarding (ETA 24h)
- jordan: pilot comms draft (ETA 2 days)

rollout-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2024-11-07 02:00 UTC (auto-check preflight in 24h) :calendar:
